info.name: Multi-Branch Inventory Tracker API
info.description:
Complete endpoint collection for the Multi-Branch Inventory Tracker backend (Laravel + JWT + 3-tier RBAC: super_admin / manager / staff).

Run the two Login requests first — they auto-save the JWT into {{admin_token}} / {{staff_token}} via a test script, so every other request just works.

═══════════════ SEEDED ACCOUNTS ═══════════════

═══════════════ ROLES ═══════════════
• super_admin — everything, all branches.
• manager — same toolset, scoped to own branch_id.
• staff — PIN login; POS transactions, receipt scans, shift open/close only.

request.description: Email + password login for super admins and managers. Swap in manager@inventory.test / 123456789 to log in as a manager. Returns { token, user }.
Backwards-compatible alias of Admin Login for older clients — identical body and response.

PIN + branch login for on-site roles (staff, and managers covering a POS shift). Matches the first staff/manager user in that branch whose PIN checks out — with seed data, PIN 123456789 in branch 1 resolves to Staff Juan. Returns { token, user, branch }.
Unified /api/login — delegates to the same handler as Staff Login.
Authenticated user with branch. /me is a legacy alias.
Public. Creates a pending user (temp password) and returns user_id for the next steps. role: owner → super_admin, manager → manager.
Public. Array format creates one branch per entry. A flat { user_id, business_name, location } format (web form) is also accepted.
Public. Creates the manager's branch and assigns the manager to it.
Public. Accepts user_id or email. Returns onboarding tracker statuses.
branch_id is optional for super admins (omit it to list all branches); managers must pass their own branch_id or get 403.
pin is required, 4–8 characters. role: staff (default) or manager. email is optional but must be unique.
Branch is inferred from the authenticated user. 422 if the user already has an open shift.
Runs variance detection — negative variances raise DiscrepancyAlerts and correct branch stock.
branch_id is required. Paginated (20/page).

item.name: Shift Logs (thin start/end aliases — staff, manager)

request.description: Thin alias over shift_logs — no per-ingredient counts. time_in is optional (defaults to now).
409 if already closed. If the shift was opened via /shifts/open (counts pending), this refuses and routes you to /shifts/close so variance detection is not skipped.

item.name: Recipes / Formula Configuration (read: any role, write: super_admin)

request.description: size: regular (default) or large — recipes are configured per product size.
One row per branch+ingredient (unique). Optionally pass capacity instead of min_threshold — the threshold is then derived from the configurable low-stock percentage (default 25%).
Additive — adds 'quantity' to whatever is already on hand and logs a 'restock' stock movement.
Edits configuration only — on-hand quantity changes go through restock or a shift close, so no StockMovement is written here. 422 if the body is empty.
Removes the branch+ingredient stock row; movement history is kept for audit.

{{branch_stock_id}} is a branch_stock row id (the id field from 'Branch Stock Levels' or 'Create Initial Stock Entry' responses) — a full audit trail of every sale, restock, and shift correction for that branch+ingredient. Paginated.
Returns every branch_stock row currently at or below its min_threshold.
{{$guid}} is Postman's built-in dynamic variable — generates a fresh UUID each send, since client_uuid must be unique per transaction.
Attach a receipt image file in the 'image' form field before sending.
Managers are auto-scoped to their branch. Optional filters: start_date+end_date, type (meeting|task|event).
Managers' branch_id is forced to their own branch. Optional attendee_ids: [user ids].
Suppliers are company-wide (no branch scoping).

request.description: Optional multipart 'photo' field uploads a supplier photo.
Includes linked ingredients (with unit costs) and the 20 most recent purchases.
is_primary=true clears the primary flag from other suppliers of that ingredient. The pricing simulator reads unit_cost from the primary supplier.
Logs a PurchaseHistory row and updates the supplier's unit_cost for that ingredient.
branch_id is required. Returns the payments list plus pending/paid/overdue totals.

category: one of the owner-managed list (defaults: rent, utilities, supplier, salary, maintenance, packaging, utensils, gas, wages, other). method: cash | bank_transfer | gcash | check | other. status: pending | paid | overdue. Optional multipart 'receipt' image (max 5MB).
Setting status to paid stamps paid_at; any other status clears it.
total_sales, total_revenue, flagged_shifts, open_alerts for the day. Omit branch_id for all branches; managers are scoped to their own.
Daily sales count + revenue between from/to (defaults: current week).
12-month revenue series for the given year and the prior year.
Negative stock variance over the range (defaults: month-to-date), as a total and broken down per branch, sorted best-to-worst.
What-if margin calculation — recomputes every active product's cost and margin with hypothetical ingredient prices. Nothing is persisted.
Global overview — super_admin only. The analytics endpoints above (/dashboard/kpis etc.) are the manager-accessible ones.
